import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the plot style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot for Sleep Duration vs Daily Steps, colored by Quality of Sleep
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Daily Steps', hue='Quality of Sleep', palette='viridis', size='Quality of Sleep', sizes=(20, 200), alpha=0.7)

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs Daily Steps colored by Quality of Sleep', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)

# Adjust legend
plt.legend(title='Quality of Sleep', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
